title: How Wicca Was Assembled
dek: Of how an Egyptologist's theory, a London magical order, a ceremonial magician's rituals and a retired colonial officer's Masonic habits became a new English religion.

panels.label: Founder Told It
panels.text: A hidden coven in the New Forest had kept the old pagan witch religion alive for centuries, and it let one initiate reveal it.

panels.label: Evidence Allows
panels.text: The coven most likely formed in the 1930s from Murray's theory. Gardner and his priestesses built the rites from ceremonial magic, Crowley and Freemasonry.
